Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p

Class SecureFrame

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.SecureFrame
public final class SecureFrame extends Object
One unit of transport traffic: a type plus an opaque payload. A frame is the thing FrameCodec seals into a length-prefixed, authenticated wire record and opens back on the far side; SecureChannel moves frames over a socket after the NoiseXXHandshake.

There are exactly two types, matching the plan's wire contract:

  • SecureFrame.Type.CONTROL - a P2pMessage serialised as JSON (chat, presence, typing, the file-transfer control plane, invites, keep-alive);
  • SecureFrame.Type.DATA - a binary file chunk (see FileTransferManager).

The type is bound into the frame's GCM tag as additional authenticated data, so a CONTROL frame can never be replayed or reinterpreted as a DATA frame. Instances are immutable; the payload array is defensively copied on the way in and out.
